description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle Database data source to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver, update Spring datasource configuration, convert Hibernate dialect, and adapt any Oracle-specific SQL syntax (including BLOB to bytea for photo data storage).
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC configuration and BLOB storage, and it stores database credentials in plaintext. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service, and Managed Identity is the planned authentication method.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the Oracle data source to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver and update datasource and Hibernate dialect configuration for PostgreSQL. Convert Oracle-specific SQL and schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, including migrating photo BLOB storage to bytea. Replace plaintext database credentials with Managed Identity authentication.
